cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 54% of AI names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Power & IPPs lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.09%; weakest is Power & IPPs at -2.96%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +16.00%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +16.00%, NXT +8.57%, SEDG +8.07%, FLNC +7.62%, ENPH +6.15%. Laggards: NRG -15.48%, VST -8.15%, BP -4.11%, FANG -3.46%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: NRG moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: NRG is -15.18% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 57 — Heating Up
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 57/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
